subject: PrivDeploy SKU decomposition, platform fee vs operator licenses, and on-call mapping
messages:
From: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@healthlynx.com>

Cc: HealthLynx Procurement <procurement@healthlynx.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify PrivDeploy packaging: operator seats vs platform fee / on-call

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team found the dedicated routing and prefix caching features compelling. Procurement asked me to get a clearer breakdown of how you bill private deployments when we run Redwood inside our VPC. Specifically: 

- How do you separate the platform (annual platform fee) from operator licenses (per-operator seat)?
- What does the SRE/on-call retainer cover vs. SLA-backed credits?
- Any standard discounts or credits for pilots (3 month pilot -> production)?

We run 4 internal SREs that will be operators for the pilot and expect ~120k tokens/day during pilot traffic. If you can share a simple SKU matrix and a sample SOW to push through our procurement review, that would help.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Reed
Head of Platform Engineering, HealthLynx
jordan.reed@healthlynx.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@healthlynx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify PrivDeploy packaging: operator seats vs platform fee / on-call

Jordan — thank you, and great to hear the team's reaction. High level answers inline below, plus proposed starting structure so procurement can review quickly. Attaching a SKU matrix and a blank SOW template (PDF + XLSX) to this thread.

High-level split:
- Platform fee: annual, covers private control plane, model catalog, console access, observability retention (standard 90 days), and ongoing platform updates. Typical starter band: $75k/yr (pilot tier) — flexible if you commit to a longer-term reserved capacity.
- Operator licenses: per-seat operator/admin account for the Console and on-call workflows. Recommend 4 operator seats for pilot, $3,000 per operator/year list (we do volume discounts at higher counts).
- On-call retainer (optional): covers SRE time for 24/7 paging and incident runbooks tied to accelerated SLAs. Default retainer: $12k/month (up to X pages/mo) with defined response SLAs and credit structure for missed targets.

Pilot credits & discounts:
- We typically offer a 25% platform fee credit for a three-month pilot that transitions to a 12-month paid term within 30 days of pilot end.
- Operator seats billed at 10% discount for pilot conversions; larger volume discounts kick in at 25+ seats.

Suggested immediate ask for procurement to speed things up:
1) Approve SOW template + pilot credit language (attached).
2) Confirm the number of operator seats to quote (looks like 4 for pilot).
3) Share expected peak qps or token/day so we can lock a more accurate dedicated-capacity recommendation.

Irene — can you check the attached SKU sheet and add a short note about the on-call SLAs we typically include? David / Marissa — want to flag commercial flex (platform fee anchoring) if HealthLynx can commit to 12 months instead of converting from pilot-to-paid.

Jordan — next step, I can send an annotated SOW and a simple pricing table by end of day.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Clarify PrivDeploy packaging: operator seats vs platform fee / on-call

Thanks Tessa — that layout is helpful. A couple of clarifications from our end before procurement starts internal review:

- Pilot sizing: our expected pilot window is 3 months with an average of 60–120k tokens/day and two peak days up to 200k tokens.
- On-call retainer: we need a clear definition of "pages/mo" and exact credit formula for missed SLAs. Can you point to sample language?
- Can you provide a SOW that shows how the platform fee credit is applied on conversion to a 12-month commitment? Procurement wants the mechanics spelled out (line items).

If we can get a draft SOW and SKU table today, I can route internally for expedited review. We prefer DocuSign to have the paperwork ready if numbers align.

Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reed <jordan.reed@healthlynx.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify PrivDeploy packaging: operator seats vs platform fee / on-call

Jordan — appreciate the upfront sizing. Quick commercial proposal below that we can put into the SOW: 

Proposal (pilot -> production conversion):
- Pilot (3 months): platform fee credited 50% for pilot period (applied as a one-time credit on invoice), with the remaining 50% deferred if you convert to a 12-month paid term within 30 days of pilot end. Example: $75k/yr starter => $18,750 credit over pilot (3 months).
- Production commitment (12 months): platform fee anchored at $60,000/yr if committed up front (saves ~20% vs list); operator seats at $2,700/operator/year for 25+ seats (we'll do $2,700 for any order >=25) and $2,850/operator for counts 10–24; pilot counts (<=9) get $2,700 on conversion as a volume-backed favor for HealthLynx.
- On-call: define pages as incidents that generate a Page with severity >=P2; retainer $12k/mo covers up to 10 pages/mo, additional pages bill at $1,200/page. SLA credits: missed Mean Time to Acknowledge (MTTA) or Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) measured and credited at 1% of monthly retainer per missed SLA (stackable up to 50%).
- Surge credit: if token/day in production grows >2x predicted within a quarter, we include 10% transient credit for the first month while we reconfigure capacity.

We can make a DocuSign-ready SOW reflecting those numbers. If HealthLynx can commit to 12 months and provide a purchase order, we can reduce the platform fee to the $60k figure in the SOW and provide a one-time implementation credit of $10k.

Jordan — would you like me to drop the SOW into DocuSign and cc procurement?

Best,
Marissa Cole

- Commercial: pilot crediting semantics agreed in principle: 50% pilot platform credit, convert-to-commit discount to $60k/yr with $10k impl credit if they sign 12-month PO.

- On-call retainer: $12k/mo up to 10 pages, $1,200/additional page, SLA credit 1%/miss up to 50%.

Action items:
